exactRunnerChanges.label: RED-only historical materialization provenance; original GREEN/common gate preserved
exactRunnerChanges.before:
if action == 'run' and command in ['red', 'green']:
    materialized_path = OUTROOT / ('materialize-tests' if phase == 'red' else 'materialize-producers') / 'phase-receipt.json'
    assert materialized_path.is_file() and not materialized_path.is_symlink()
    materialized_bytes = materialized_path.read_bytes()
    control_pins.append((materialized_path, identity(materialized_bytes)))
    materialized = json.loads(materialized_bytes)
    assert materialized['action'] == 'materialize' and materialized['command'] == phase
    assert materialized['bindingIdentity'] == identity(binding_bytes)
    assert materialized['publishedSubject'] == cfg['publishedSubject']
    assert materialized['testIdentities'] == TEST_IDENTITIES
    assert materialized['sourceVectorIdentity'] == cfg['sourceVectorIdentity']
    assert materialized['scopeCompleted'] and materialized['sourceAndSupervisorMetadataPreserved']
    assert materialized['fullRuntimeInputsInspected'] is False
    assert materialized['fullRuntimeInputsPreserved'] is None and materialized['inputsPreserved'] is None
    assert materialized['writtenPaths'] == written_paths and materialized['interruptions'] == []
    assert all(materialized['cleanup'][key] == [] for key in [
        'unknownPrimaryLaunches', 'capturedSessionMembersAfter', 'newTestTempsRemaining', 'taskTmpEntriesAfter'])
    assert materialized['cleanup']['viteTempAbsent'] is True
    assert not any(materialized.get(key) for key in ['executionError', 'postflightError', 'transientCleanupError'])
exactRunnerChanges.after:
if action == 'run' and command in ['red', 'green']:
    if phase == 'red':
        historical = cfg['historicalTestMaterialization']
        assert historical == combined_r1['historicalTestMaterialization']
        assert cfg['behavioralAttempts']['materializeTests'] == 0
        assert combined_r1['execution']['attempts']['materializeTests'] == 0
        assert cfg['acceptedCombinedRed'] is None and cfg['acceptedCombinedGreen'] is None
        assert cfg['producerR2ReviewedAndPublished'] is False and cfg['producerActualReadbackAccepted'] is False
        historical_controls = {}
        for historical_name in ['originalRunner', 'originalBinding']:
            historical_control = historical[historical_name]
            historical_path = pathlib.Path(historical_control['path'])
            assert historical_path.is_file() and not historical_path.is_symlink()
            historical_data = historical_path.read_bytes()
            assert identity(historical_data) == historical_control['identity']
            control_pins.append((historical_path, historical_control['identity']))
            historical_controls[historical_name] = historical_data
        historical_cfg = json.loads(historical_controls['originalBinding'])
        assert historical_cfg['publishedR1'] == historical['originalR1']['publication']
        assert historical_cfg['combinedR1Identity'] == historical['originalR1']['identity']
        assert identity(historical_cfg['combinedR1Body'].encode()) == historical['originalR1']['identity']
        assert historical_cfg['runnerIdentity'] == historical['originalRunner']['identity']
        assert historical_cfg['publishedSubject'] == historical['originalPublishedSubject'] == cfg['publishedSubject']
        assert historical_cfg['testIdentities'] == historical['originalTestIdentities'] == TEST_IDENTITIES
        assert historical_cfg['sourceVectorIdentity'] == historical['originalSourceVectorIdentity'] == cfg['sourceVectorIdentity']
        assert historical_cfg['sourcePins'] == cfg['sourcePins'] == combined_r1['currentNineSourceRows']
        assert historical_cfg['inputFiles'] == cfg['inputFiles']
        assert historical_cfg['beforeSourceOverlay'] == cfg['beforeSourceOverlay']
        assert historical_cfg['sourceOverlay'] == cfg['sourceOverlay']
        assert historical['writtenPaths'] == written_paths
        for historical_role, historical_pin in [
            ('historicalTestMaterializationRootActual', historical['acceptedPublication']['root']),
            ('historicalTestMaterializationIndependentActual', historical['acceptedPublication']['independent']),
        ]:
            historical_reviews = [row for row in cfg['acceptedReviewBodies'] if row['role'] == historical_role]
            assert len(historical_reviews) == 1 and historical_reviews[0]['identity'] == historical_pin
        historical_outer_body = cfg['historicalEvidenceBodies']['testMaterializationOuter']
        assert historical_outer_body['identity'] == historical['observedOuter']
        assert identity(historical_outer_body['body'].encode()) == historical['observedOuter']
        historical_outer = json.loads(historical_outer_body['body'])
        assert historical_outer['observedOuterExit'] == historical_outer['finalToolResult']['exit_code'] == 0
        assert historical_outer['selectedAttemptSpent'] is True and historical_outer['replayed'] is False
        assert historical_outer['runtimeTestPackageExecuted'] is False
        historical_refused_body = cfg['historicalEvidenceBodies']['refusedCombinedOuter']
        assert historical_refused_body['identity'] == combined_r1['supersedes']['originalRefusedAttempt']['outer']
        assert identity(historical_refused_body['body'].encode()) == historical_refused_body['identity']
        historical_refused = json.loads(historical_refused_body['body'])
        assert historical_refused['observedOuterExit'] == historical_refused['finalToolResult']['exit_code'] == 2
        assert historical_refused['attemptSpent'] is True and historical_refused['replayed'] is False
        materialized_path = pathlib.Path(historical['receiptPath'])
    else:
        materialized_path = OUTROOT / 'materialize-producers' / 'phase-receipt.json'
    assert materialized_path.is_file() and not materialized_path.is_symlink()
    materialized_bytes = materialized_path.read_bytes()
    control_pins.append((materialized_path, identity(materialized_bytes)))
    materialized = json.loads(materialized_bytes)
    assert materialized['action'] == 'materialize' and materialized['command'] == phase
    if phase == 'red':
        assert identity(materialized_bytes) == historical['receipt']
        assert materialized['bindingIdentity'] == historical['originalBinding']['identity']
        assert materialized['runnerIdentity'] == historical['originalRunner']['identity']
        assert materialized['publishedR1'] == historical['originalR1']['publication']
        assert materialized['sourcePins'] == cfg['sourcePins']
        assert {key: materialized['before']['source'][key] for key in ['bytes', 'sha256', 'gitBlob']} == historical['sourceBefore']
        assert {key: materialized['after']['source'][key] for key in ['bytes', 'sha256', 'gitBlob']} == historical['sourceAfter']
        assert materialized['commandCompletedNormally'] is False and materialized['semanticAdmissionComplete'] is False
    else:
        assert materialized['bindingIdentity'] == identity(binding_bytes)
    assert materialized['publishedSubject'] == cfg['publishedSubject']
    assert materialized['testIdentities'] == TEST_IDENTITIES
    assert materialized['sourceVectorIdentity'] == cfg['sourceVectorIdentity']
    assert materialized['scopeCompleted'] and materialized['sourceAndSupervisorMetadataPreserved']
    assert materialized['fullRuntimeInputsInspected'] is False
    assert materialized['fullRuntimeInputsPreserved'] is None and materialized['inputsPreserved'] is None
    assert materialized['writtenPaths'] == written_paths and materialized['interruptions'] == []
    assert all(materialized['cleanup'][key] == [] for key in [
        'unknownPrimaryLaunches', 'capturedSessionMembersAfter', 'newTestTempsRemaining', 'taskTmpEntriesAfter'])
    assert materialized['cleanup']['viteTempAbsent'] is True
    assert not any(materialized.get(key) for key in ['executionError', 'postflightError', 'transientCleanupError'])
